newsitem.title: CANADA: Power Plus terminates acting COO.
newsitem.headline: Power Plus terminates acting COO.

text.p: Power Plus Corp said it terminated its executive employment agreement with G. Thomas Alison, effective December 18, 1996.

The company said that Alison had been acting in the role of chief operating officer. The company had previously reported that it had made the agreement with Alison subject to the fulfilment of certain conditions.

The company said it was continuing with its expansion and implementation of its PLAN 2000 5-year business plan, relying upon the management team assembled over the last six months. The Powerful Stuff management team has a strong marketing, operations and financial background based on extensive experience in retailing, marketing, multi business unit management, real estate and development, start-ups, and corporate finance, the company said.
Power Plus Corp, publicly held, trades on the Alberta Stock Exchange under the symbol "PPC" and on Nasdaq's OTC Bulletin Board under the symbol "PPCO"
It was formerly called Battery One Inc.
